title: Tax break for affordable housing in Bronx Fordham-Bedford cluster
summary: The resolution grants a property tax exemption under state law for an affordable housing project at three lots in the Bronx, part of the Fordham Bedford Cluster Phase 3. The owner is Neighborhood Renewal Housing Development Fund Corporation, a nonprofit housing development fund company. The exemption runs for up to six years from June 23, 2021 and depends on compliance with an affordable housing regulatory agreement with the city's Department of Housing Preservation and Development.
